definition: Labelled time is, shot by shot, the union of the intervals a label table states present or absent (the four regimes for confinement); intervals stated uncertain, not observable or unassessed are not labelled time. Labelled shots are the shots with any labelled time. Tokamak-SI counts every released tier and split; the reviewed subset counts the shots whose labels a person reviewed.

legacy.label: Heidbrink annotation
legacy.definition: the annotated shots' whole windows; unannotated time is listed absent, which the annotation under-counts, so legacy absent time is not reviewed absence

reviewed.note: every shot of the table was saved by a reviewer

notes: the ECE hand-drawn boxes (a second legacy annotation, on another diagnostic) are not counted
ae.name: AE

legacy.label: Gill and Butt tables merged
legacy.definition: the curated L, H, QH and WPQH intervals of the merged table, less the blind split (never read) and the one H/L conflict interval

tokamak_si.label: confine-ours roster
tokamak_si.definition: shared definition on classes 1 to 4 (high, low, qh, wpqh) of the roster; class 5 (below the confidence floor) is uncertain; beam-on time only, other time is not assessed

reviewed.note: the roster is a network's reading; no person reviewed it

notes: Tokamak-SI is the experimental, unreviewed roster: segments are the network's reading of D-alpha, density, beta_N, W_MHD and beam power, labels and inputs share the 0D traces
confinement.name: confinement

legacy.label: D. Smith's windows
legacy.definition: the 1 ms cells wholly inside a Smith window, shots with a hand-labelled ELM; windows are selected around known ELMs, so absent time is not continuous-discharge absence

reviewed.note: every shot of the table was saved by a reviewer

notes: legacy is Smith's windows as the benchmark uses them; the older WPQH onset table is the other legacy source (alternatives)

alternatives.name: legacy onset table (Hiro's ELM labels, bins over a fixed window)

elm.name: ELMs

legacy.label: Seo growth-phase labels
legacy.definition: deviation: matched growth-phase label support on observable catalog-window 10 ms bins; temporal holes excluded

tokamak_si.label: interval labels, population
tokamak_si.definition: deviation: the stream's record, labelled 10 ms bins from the measured plasma start to catalog window end; uncertain and unobservable bins excluded

reviewed.note: a rule's output; no person reviewed the intervals

notes: Tokamak-SI is the interval labeller's output on the population, scored as development cross-validation; the blind shots carry no tearing-mode labels
legacy and Tokamak-SI time are not on one definition: the legacy figure is the label support on observable bins, the Tokamak-SI figure the labelled bins from the measured plasma start

alternatives.name: development cohort (union of the interval table)

tm.name: tearing modes

legacy.label: no legacy label set
legacy.definition: the published sawtooth detectors are from another machine and ship no label table

tokamak_si.label: released population labels
tokamak_si.definition: shared definition on the physics-rule labels: present (a periodic relaxation train) and absent (ECE-tested absence) count; the q-prior states, other uncertain time and unassessed time do not

reviewed.note: the shots a person drew spans on, anchored to earlier rule suggestions

notes: the labels are rule output, unvalidated against an independent truth; only the reviewed spans are human-drawn
sawtooth.name: sawtooth

legacy.label: Hanson onset list
legacy.definition: onset times only: a shot count, no labelled time

tokamak_si.label: onset windows
tokamak_si.definition: shared definition on the Hanson shots: present is one minimal slice from each listed onset; absent is assumed before the first precursor; the pre-onset window, the screened comparison shots and the unassessed time are not labelled

reviewed.note: a completeness assumption; no person reviewed the spans

notes: present time is a convention (one slice per onset), not a measured duration; absent time rests on a completeness assumption
rwm.name: RWM

tokamak_si.label: detachment labels
tokamak_si.definition: deviation: the bins that carry a state (TangTV, with or without an agreeing second indicator); bins with no vote or a conflict are not labelled

reviewed.note: indicator votes; no person reviewed the bins

notes: the record is the detachment stream's committed file; its tiers are TangTV with an agreeing Afrac vote and TangTV only
detachment.name: detachment
